Class GameWindow

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Manages the main application window, including its state, size, position, monitor, framerate, and mouse/cursor behavior. Provides events for window and mouse state changes.

UnfocusedFrameRateLimit

Target frames-per-second to apply when the window is unfocused (in FPS). A value of 0 disables the unfocused frame rate limit (no restriction). Used by ShapeEngine.Core.GameWindow.IsUnfocusedFrameRateLimitActive() to decide if the unfocused cap is active.

public int UnfocusedFrameRateLimit

Field Value

int

Remarks

If IdleFrameRateLimit is active as well, the lower of the two limits will be used.

Properties

AdaptiveFpsLimiter

If enabled the FPS limiter will dynamically adjust the frame rate limit based on performance. If an FpsLimit is set (whether through VSync with a valid monitor refresh rate or manually), the adaptive limiter will try to keep the frame rate close to that limit and reduce the limit if performance drops. If no FpsLimit is set (0 = unlimited), the adaptive limiter will try to keep the frame rate between its configured minimum and maximum limits, trying to reach the maximum limit when possible and never going below the minimum limit.

public AdaptiveFpsLimiter AdaptiveFpsLimiter { get; }

Property Value

AdaptiveFpsLimiter

Remarks

Can be enabled or disabled through Enabled at any time.

FpsLimit

Gets or sets the frames-per-second limit used when VSync is disabled. 0 means unlimited. VSync has to be Disabled to allow an unlimited frame rate.

public int FpsLimit { get; set; }

Property Value

int

Remarks

When VSync is disabled, assigning to this property will update TargetFps accordingly. Otherwise, changing this property has no immediate effect until VSync is set to Disabled.

FullscreenAutoRestoring

Gets or sets whether the window should automatically restore from fullscreen when focus is lost. This only affects fullscreen mode and does not affect borderless fullscreen!

public bool FullscreenAutoRestoring { get; set; }

VSync

Gets or sets the current vertical sync mode for the window. Changing this property updates the effective TargetFps according to the selected VsyncMode. Setting to Disabled causes the engine to use the manual FpsLimit for frame limiting.

ActivateBorderlessFullscreen()

Activates borderless fullscreen mode.

public bool ActivateBorderlessFullscreen()

Returns

bool

True if borderless fullscreen was activated; otherwise, false.

Remarks

FullscreenAutoRestoring does not affect borderless fullscreen! Prefer ToggleFullscreen() or ActivateFullscreen() over borderless fullscreen. Since raylib 6.0 there is not much difference between Fullscreen and Borderless Fullscreen anymore.
